expectations.text: Eruptibility: actors and pressures are already in motion when PCs arrive
expectations.evidence: Line 92: 'The adventure remains latent until the party asks.' The entire design is built around 'Trigger Questions' — nothing is in motion. The town is peaceful with no active situation.

expectations.text: At least two factions or actors at Corvenna have independent agendas
expectations.evidence: 'No active disputes. No contested matches underway.' NPCs 'are ordinary, unremarkable people. None have obvious agendas. None initiate conversation about disputes.' Zero factions with agendas present.

expectations.text: Visible tells exist that the party can notice without asking
expectations.evidence: 'A tangible, comfortable quiet — not eerie or hostile, but genuinely at peace.' Nothing to notice. The party must ask 'Trigger Questions' to unlock any content.

expectations.text: Situation advances if the party does nothing — consequences of inaction visible
expectations.evidence: 'Nothing in Corvenna's surface appearance demands action. The town does exactly what it is designed to do: it stands ready.' The situation is completely static without party questions.

expectations.text: No specific NPC question or trigger gates all discovery
expectations.evidence: The entire structure is organized around 'Trigger Questions' — five categories of questions the party must ask. 'Until the party asks, Corvenna remains what it is designed to be.' Discovery is entirely gated by asking.

expectations.text: Content grounded in established Corvenna wiki facts
expectations.evidence: Uses Corvenna's established facts: neutral ground, champion combat, eastern reef location, unknown keepers.
